findings: The June17,2026 operator release establishes financing and future phase dates, not a dated observation of physical construction. A construction-progress image caption does not establish the camera date.
The EBRD project56480 description was disclosed and last updated April24,2026. June17 is the approval date, not a new site inspection. Its prior-construction statement cannot be refreshed to June17.

The public lender-linked Non-Technical Summary is version1.0, dated August25,2025. Page13 reports completed excavation and preparation for foundation pouring at the data-centre plot, but is outside the required window.

NTS page9 Figure2-1 separately identifies a data-centre plot, buffer station and IT Park phases. The map labels its coordinate system Decimal Degrees WGS84 and bears May27,2025 preparation date. It is a potentially useful identity lead, not a selected numeric campus locator here.

The NTS describes buffer-station and underground-power-line permit holds separately from continuing data-centre construction. The newer EBRD description withdraws the adjoining BESS plot from the project. Neither statement is collapsed into a data-centre cancellation.

The NTS page2 explicitly restricts third-party disclosure and describes proprietary/confidential material. Public EBRD delivery is recorded, but no open licence is asserted, no map is digitized and no source pages or imagery are redistributed.
NestOne, C65 ninth floor, 1a Islam Karimov Street is a company contact address, not proof of the TAS-1 project location. No office, city or IT Park centroid is selected.
No new source fact is admitted and no full-geometry non-overlap result is claimed. Older direct-construction social posts and later financial reprints do not close the fresh-observation gate.
